title: health endpoint returns service_status_ok
description: Verify that the GET /health endpoint returns a successful response indicating the backend service is reachable and operational.

title: branding endpoint returns_public_branding_settings
description: Test the GET /api/settings/branding endpoint to ensure it returns the correct public branding settings for the frontend to render.

title: accounts_by_id_endpoint_returns_account_existence
description: Validate the GET /api/public/accounts-by-id/:taxId endpoint returns true if the account exists and false or not found if it does not.

title: register_endpoint_creates_user_with_correct_role
description: Test POST /api/auth/register to register new users with different email domains and identifiers, verifying correct role assignment (B2B, Educational, Personal) and validation errors for malformed inputs.

title: auth_tunnel_challenge_returns_challenge_token
description: Verify POST /api/auth/tunnel/challenge returns a valid challenge token when provided with a valid invite token.

title: setup_password_endpoint_activates_account
description: Test POST /api/auth/tunnel/setup-password to ensure account activation with valid tokens and proper error handling for invalid or expired tokens.

title: admin_login_accepts_valid_credentials
description: Verify POST /api/admin/login accepts valid owner/admin credentials and rejects invalid credentials.

title: edu_validate_endpoint_approves_education_request
description: Test POST /api/edu/validate/:requestId to ensure that an authenticated admin can approve an education request and update the user role accordingly.

title: edu_analyze_doc_returns_analysis_metadata
description: Verify POST /api/edu/analyze-doc accepts document payloads, returns analysis metadata and requestId, and handles corrupted or unsupported documents with appropriate errors.

title: invite_endpoint_requires_auth_and_valid_email
description: Test POST /api/auth/invite to ensure only authenticated admins can send invites, validate email formats, handle duplicate invites, and reject unauthorized requests.
